prompt: Create a vertical 3:4 playful fashion portrait collage featuring Mel: a stylish young adult man centered in a full-body realistic photo, leaning casually against a pale gray horizontal wooden plank wall. He has thick wavy dark hair, a neatly groomed full beard, warm medium skin, expressive dark eyes, and a calm confident expression while looking slightly to the side. Dress him in a light blue oversized denim jacket, white T-shirt, light wash loose jeans, white sneakers, a silver watch, and a small pale blue crossbody bag worn diagonally. His hands are in his pockets and his legs are crossed at the ankles. Surround him with exactly six cute sticker-style chibi versions of the same man, each with a thick white outline and soft drop shadow: top left making a peace sign, top right standing with hands in pockets and big eyes, middle left holding a bubble tea drink, middle right winking and giving a thumbs-up, bottom left making a finger-heart gesture, and bottom right standing calmly with hands in pockets. Add colorful hand-drawn doodles and words around the composition: blue “Shine” near the upper left center, yellow “Smile” on the right, yellow “Bright Day” on the left middle-lower area, pink “Happy” on the right lower-middle area, a white speech bubble at the bottom reading “Mel” in blue with a small pink heart, and light blue “Cool” at bottom left with black sunglasses. Include additional small doodles: pink hearts, white sparkles, yellow stars, a white cloud, small swirl marks, and smiley accents. Use a cheerful social-media sticker aesthetic, high detail, clean lighting, soft shadows, crisp outlines, pastel colors, and a polished generated-photo look. Keep the central portrait realistic and the six surrounding mini characters chibi caricatures matching the same outfit and facial identity. No extra people, no watermark, no messy text.

promptZh: 创作一张 3:4 竖版趣味时尚肖像拼贴，主角为 Mel：一位时尚的年轻男性，居中全身写实照片，随意地倚靠在浅灰色横向木板墙前。他留着浓密的波浪形深色头发，修剪整齐的络腮胡，肤色温暖适中，深邃的眼睛富有表现力，神情冷静自信，微微侧头。身穿浅蓝色宽松牛仔外套、白色 T 恤、浅色宽松牛仔裤、白色运动鞋，佩戴银色手表，斜挎一个小巧的浅蓝色斜挎包。双手插兜，双脚脚踝交叉。周围环绕着 6 个完全相同的该男性 Q 版贴纸形象，每个贴纸都有粗白色轮廓和柔和的投影：左上角比剪刀手，右上角双手插兜大眼睛站立，左中拿着珍珠奶茶，右中眨眼并竖起大拇指，左下角比心，右下角双手插兜冷静站立。在构图周围添加色彩鲜艳的手绘涂鸦和文字：左上中心附近蓝色的“Shine”，右侧黄色的“Smile”，左中下区域黄色的“Bright Day”，右中下区域粉色的“Happy”，底部有一个白色对话框，里面用蓝色写着“Mel”并配有一个粉色小爱心，左下角有浅蓝色的“Cool”和黑色太阳镜。添加额外的装饰小涂鸦：粉色爱心、白色闪光、黄色星星、白云、小旋涡和笑脸符号。采用欢快的社交媒体贴纸美学，高细节，光线清晰，阴影柔和，轮廓分明，色彩柔和，呈现精致的生成照片质感。保持中心肖像写实，周围的 6 个迷你角色为 Q 版漫画形象，服装和面部特征需保持一致。不要出现其他人，不要有水印，不要有杂乱的文字。
